I. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA (1) Supplier must be a manufacturer of Liquid Oxygen with minimum 50 Ton Liquid Oxygen per da y production capability. The following documents to be submitted in support of above:- (i) If the supply was given to any SAIL Unit, then the documents mentioned at (a) [below] only to b e submitted: (a) Self Attested copy of Purchase Order and Quantity Completion certificate against PO from S AIL Unit.

(ii) If the supply was given in any Organization other than SAIL Unit, then the documents mentione d below are to be submitted: (a) Self attested copies of Documents in the form of (i) Purchase Order and (ii) Few Invoice copies spread over the delivery period of a Purchase Order Tax Invoice or S upply Completion Certificate issued by the end Customer to be submitted. (b) Completion Certificate should mention the Purchase Order, Supplied quantity of LOX, mode of Supply and the duration of the Supply. Completion Certificate in Email from the Official Email address of the end Customer will be acceptable. The Purchase Order and Completion Certificat e / Tax Invoice so submitted should be in the name of participating tenderer. (c) A Self Attested Summary statement giving details of the Purchase Order number, Cryogenic Oxygen Tanker Number, Quantity of LOX (in Ton) accepted by customer, date of Supply of LOX, Invoice Number, Invoiced ate, Name of Customer will be submitted. The Total Quantity of LOX (i n Tons) supplied against each Purchase Order must be mentioned in the Summary Statement. An Excel sheet of the above Summary Statement (with supplied quantity mentioned in Ton) sha ll be submitted for verification by RSP. (d) Substantially completed ongoing Purchase Orders having duration of contract of more than one year can be considered for Technical Evaluation as per Eligibility criteria, if the party has co mpleted atleast one year of the period of Purchase Order and at least 50% of the Purchase Ord er quantity (for the entire period of the Purchase Order) is completed ending last day of the mo nth previous to the one in which Tender is issued. (3) The Supplier must have minimum 5 (Five) numbers of Roadworthy Cryogenic Oxygen Tankers with valid PESO certification, each Tanker having a minimum capacity of 15 Metric Tonne (MT) for transportation of Liquid Oxygen, in Owner’s /Partner’s / Company’s name/ leased by them and sho uld submit following documents as part of Eligibility Criteria: - a) Self-Certified copy of registration book of all the tankers. b) Certificate issued by PESO to be submitted for all the Tankers. The PESO certificate must be val id at the time of submission of bid. c) In case, any tanker is leased, then lease/ agreement document of such Cryogenic tankers to be submitted. Lease agreement should be in the name of Bidder. * Non-submission of the documents towards fulfillment of eligibility criteria of the bid, as listed abo ve, during bid submission, may lead to rejection of the bid. II. SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. Supply of Liquid Oxygen will be done by Successful Bidder in PESO certified Cryogenic Oxygen T ankers. 2. Successful Bidder shall ensure that each Cryogenic Oxygen Tanker must have valid statutory do cuments and PESO Certificate. 3. Successful Bidder shall arrange e-Way bill. 4. Successful bidder will supply Liquid Oxygen as directed by SAIL-RSP. 5. Payment will be payable to the Supplier on the Weighment Quantity or the Challan quantity, whi chever is lower, ie., payment will be made to the Supplier on the Goods Acceptance (GARN) quanti ty. 6. Successful Bidder shall supply Liquid Oxygen as per requirement of RSP and LOX quantity to be supplied will be communicated to supplier by Oxygen Plant, RSP. 50 Ton per Day will be the (tenta tive) Minimum Acceptable Quantity of LOX Supply. 7. Unloading/ Decantation of Liquid Oxygen from the Cryogenic Oxygen Tanker to the Cryogenic O xygen Tank of SAIL-RSP shall be the responsibility of the supplier(s). 8. The Quantity of the Purchase Order may be increased or decreased by upto 25%, within the Deli very Period, at the same Terms and Conditions as those mentioned in the Purchase Order. In case the order quantity is increased, the order validity shall be extended accordingly, unilaterally by RS P. Vendor should be in a position to supply the additional quantity (+25% of the bid qty if required) within the delivery period, without any other changes in terms and conditions of the con tract. The bidders are required to confirm acceptance of the same in the techno-commercial offer. 9. SAIL-RSP reserves the right to source the material in the bid from two sources to ensure un-inter

rupted availability of material. Total or part quantity, ordered on a firm, may be diverted from one firm to another, in case of failure of the firm to supply as per the terms of the contract/ SAIL-RSP's requirement. 10. Ordered quantity may be fore-closed incase the availability of Oxygen in RSP increases after c ommissioning of new Oxygen Plant. SAIL-RSP will have sole discretion for foreclosure of ordered q uantity in such event and successful bidders will be informed in advance by RSP. In such a case, S AIL-RSP reserves the right to fore-close the order(s) with 15 days prior intimation to the supplier(s) . 11. Guarantee Certificate: Supplied Liquid Oxygen will be guaranteed for minimum 99.6% purity. Guarantee Certificate will be submitted by the successful bidder(s) with details of the Purchase Or der, Tanker Number and date of supply. III. DELIVERY REQUIREMENT: · Delivery period - 180 days, wherein, the delivery will be done in phases, as per requireme nt of SAIL-RSP. · The order quantity may, however, be distributed as per the applicable splitting rule for so urcing the material from the required number of sources. The detailed delivery schedule sh all be as per SAIL-RSP's back-up purchase order(s). · 50 Ton per Day will be the (tentative) Minimum Acceptable Quantity of LOX Supply irrespe ctive of the allocated order quantity, unless communicated otherwise by SAIL-RSP. Guarantee Certificate will be submitted by the Supplier with details of the Purchase Order, Tanker Number and Date of Supply. V. PRICE VARIATION CLAUSE: Price shall remain firm for the Purchase Order. VI. PACKAGING CLAUSE: Not Applicable VII. PAYMENT TERM: 100% against GARN (material acceptance) within 30 days. BIDDERS TO NOTE: 1.
